faqs.q: Where is Carzy World?
faqs.a: We're at 137-G, Jln Permata 1/KS09, Pusat Perniagaan Bestari, Taman Perindustrian Air Hitam Phase 1 & 2, 42000 Klang, Selangor. Tap 'Get directions' to open it in Google Maps.

faqs.q: What are your opening hours?
faqs.a: Monday to Friday 10am to 7pm, and Saturday 10am to 4:30pm. We're closed on Sunday.

faqs.q: Which car brands do you work on?
faqs.a: All car brands are welcome. Recent jobs include a Tesla Model 3, an Isuzu D-Max, a Mercedes-Benz C230 and a 1988 Mercedes 190E 2.5-16.

faqs.q: How much will my repair cost?
faqs.a: We don't publish prices because every car and problem is different. WhatsApp us your car model, year and the problem and we'll give you a quote. New customers get a 5% discount (terms apply).

faqs.q: How do I book my car in?
faqs.a: The quickest way is WhatsApp on +60 17-693 3936. You can also call the same number during opening hours or email yc.carzyworld@gmail.com.

faqs.q: Do you repair electric cars?
faqs.a: Yes. In October 2026 we replaced an upper arm on a Tesla Model 3 and sorted out a fast-charging fault on it.

faqs.q: Can you fix wiring problems other workshops couldn't?
faqs.a: Yes, electrical and wiring faults are a regular job for us. Our videos show a fault that kept coming back, and batteries that kept dying after two other workshops couldn't find the cause. Tell us on WhatsApp what happens and when.

car-servicing-oil-change.title: Car servicing and oil change
car-servicing-oil-change.card: Regular servicing, major service and oil change for every brand.
car-servicing-oil-change.h1: Car servicing and oil change in Klang
car-servicing-oil-change.meta_title: Car Servicing & Oil Change in Klang
car-servicing-oil-change.meta_description: Car servicing, major service and oil change at Carzy World, Air Hitam, Klang. All car brands welcome. WhatsApp +60 17-693 3936 for a quote.
car-servicing-oil-change.prefill_topic: a car service or oil change
car-servicing-oil-change.intro: Regular servicing keeps your car reliable and helps catch small problems early. We do normal services, major services and oil changes for all car brands, from city cars to pickups and continental cars.
covers: Engine oil and oil filter change
General repairs and maintenance found during the service
Pickups and 4x4s, such as a recent Isuzu D-Max major service
car-servicing-oil-change.signs_h2: When to bring your car in
signs: Your service reminder or sticker says it's due
The oil warning light comes on
The engine sounds rougher or louder than usual
You're planning a long drive and want the car checked first
car-servicing-oil-change.body: Tell us your car model, year and mileage on WhatsApp, and we'll let you know what the service should include and give you a quote. We keep you updated while your car is with us.

faqs.q: What's the difference between a normal service and a major service?
faqs.a: A normal service is mainly the oil and oil filter change with basic checks. A major service usually adds more items such as other filters, fluids and spark plugs, depending on your car's schedule. WhatsApp us your car model and mileage and we'll tell you which one is due.

faqs.q: Do you service pickups and 4x4s?
faqs.a: Yes. All car brands are welcome, and we recently did a major service on an Isuzu D-Max.

engine-gearbox-repair.title: Engine and gearbox repair
engine-gearbox-repair.card: Engine problems, leaks, warning lights and gearbox repair.
engine-gearbox-repair.h1: Engine and gearbox repair in Klang
engine-gearbox-repair.meta_description: Engine and gearbox repair at Carzy World, Air Hitam, Klang: leaks, warning lights, rough running and gearbox problems. All car brands. WhatsApp +60 17-693 3936.
engine-gearbox-repair.intro: Engine and gearbox problems are worth checking early, before a small fault turns into a big repair. WhatsApp us what you're noticing and we'll tell you what to expect.
covers: Oil and coolant leaks, like a recent Mercedes-Benz C230
signs: Engine warning light on the dashboard
Oil or coolant drips under the car
Rough idle, shaking or loss of power
Gears slipping, jerking or slow to engage
engine-gearbox-repair.body: Send us a short video or a description of the problem on WhatsApp. It helps us understand what's going on before you bring the car in.

faqs.q: Can I keep driving with the engine warning light on?
faqs.a: If the light is flashing, or the car feels very different, stop driving and get it checked, because it can mean a serious fault. If it's steady and the car drives normally, book a check soon. Either way, WhatsApp us and we'll advise you.

faqs.q: Do you fix oil and coolant leaks?
faqs.a: Yes. We recently fixed coolant and oil leaks on a Mercedes-Benz C230 and checked the warning lights it was showing.

car-aircond-service.title: Car aircond diagnostics and service
car-aircond-service.card: Aircond not cold, weak airflow or smells: we find the cause.
car-aircond-service.h1: Car aircond service and diagnostics in Klang
car-aircond-service.meta_title: Car Aircond Service & Diagnostics in Klang
car-aircond-service.meta_description: Car aircond not cold? Carzy World in Air Hitam, Klang checks and services car aircond for all brands. WhatsApp +60 17-693 3936.
car-aircond-service.intro: In Malaysian weather, a weak aircond makes every drive uncomfortable. We check the system to find out why it isn't cooling properly, then service or repair what's needed.
covers: Aircond diagnostics to find the cause
signs: Air isn't as cold as it used to be
Cold at first, then warm after a while
Weak airflow from the vents
A bad smell or strange noise when the aircond is on
car-aircond-service.body: Tell us on WhatsApp what the aircond is doing and when it started. We'll check the system and let you know what we find.

faqs.q: Why is my car aircond not cold?
faqs.a: Common causes include low refrigerant from a leak, a blocked filter, a cooling fan problem or a faulty compressor. A proper check finds the real cause, so you don't pay for parts you don't need.

faqs.q: Do you only top up the gas?
faqs.a: We check the system first to find out why it isn't cooling, then service or repair what's needed. Topping up without finding a leak usually means the problem comes back.

suspension-brakes-exhaust.intro: Brakes and suspension keep you safe and the car comfortable. We check and repair suspension, brakes and exhaust systems for all car brands.
covers: Suspension repair, such as the upper arm we replaced on a Tesla Model 3
signs: Squealing or grinding when you brake
The car pulls to one side or the steering shakes
Knocking over bumps or a bouncy ride
A louder exhaust, rattles or exhaust smell in the cabin
suspension-brakes-exhaust.body: Brake and suspension problems can get worse quickly. If something feels wrong, WhatsApp us and bring the car in for a check.

faqs.q: My brakes squeal. Is it urgent?
faqs.a: A squeal can mean worn brake pads, and grinding usually means they're worn right down. Get them checked soon, because worn brakes take longer to stop the car.

faqs.q: Why is my exhaust suddenly louder?
faqs.a: A louder exhaust usually means a leak or a damaged part in the exhaust system. It's worth checking, especially if you can smell exhaust inside the car.

electrical-wiring-diagnosis.title: Electrical and wiring fault finding
electrical-wiring-diagnosis.card: Difficult wiring and electrical faults traced and fixed.

electrical-wiring-diagnosis.meta_description: Difficult car wiring and electrical faults traced and fixed at Carzy World, Air Hitam, Klang. Even other workshops send cars to us. WhatsApp +60 17-693 3936.
electrical-wiring-diagnosis.intro: Electrical faults can be hard to pin down: a warning light that comes and goes, or something that only fails sometimes. Tracing difficult wiring problems is work we're known for.
covers: Warning lights and difficult problems other shops couldn't solve
signs: Warning lights that come and go
Electrical parts that work sometimes and not others
Fuses that keep blowing
A battery that keeps going flat
electrical-wiring-diagnosis.body: Our videos show a fault that kept coming back, and batteries that kept dying after two other workshops couldn't find the cause. Tell us what's happening on WhatsApp, and when it happens.

faqs.q: Other workshops couldn't find the fault. Can you help?
faqs.a: Difficult wiring and electrical problems are what we're known for. WhatsApp us what you've already tried and what the car is doing, and we'll take a look.

faqs.q: My battery keeps going flat. Is it the battery?
faqs.a: Not always. A flat battery can also come from a charging problem or something drawing power when the car is off. A check finds the cause, so you don't replace parts for nothing.

faqs.q: Do you work on Tesla?

faqs.q: Do you only repair electric cars?
faqs.a: No. We work on all car brands, petrol, diesel and electric.
